Name: Multiplayer Portal Guns
Author: TrollTheBotman
Description:
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿[code]﻿[/code]
[*](Recommended) Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4579]Mod Settings Tab Plus[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip into Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to use[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Craft a portal gun for one piece of wood. 
[*]Hold the Portal Gun.
[*]Put your cursor on the desired position and press the tool and action buttons to spawn portals.
[*]Both portals must be on a valid position with a valid tile to the right.[code]﻿[/code]
[/list][list]
[*]Each player has their own portals that target one another
[/list][list]
[*]For a player to remove their portals, press [b]R[/b]
[/list] ﻿ ﻿﻿(can be changed in the config file or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4579]Mod settings tab plus[/url]﻿)[list]
[*]The host may remove all the portals on their farm by pressing [b]PageDown [/b]
[/list] ﻿ ﻿(can be changed in the config file or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4579]Mod settings tab plus[/url]﻿)
[size=4]Notes[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Be sure to back up your save before using just in case![/size]
[*][size=2]This can intercept the NPC’s and mess with their paths for the day.[/size]
[*][size=2]Currently doesn't work with festivals[/size]
[*][size=2]When entering the mine through a portal, the player will always appear at the bottom of the ladder[/size]
[/list]
[url=https://github.com/joshjke/MultiplayerPortalGuns/tree/master]Source Code[/url]

Downloads.Description: Adds portal guns for multiplayer. Also fixes bugs from the previous version.
